rationale: The existing v0.3 per-episode budgets were calibrated on Codex Desktop rollout traces where raw context usage included large executor overhead and scoring windows cut to 3600-5200 tokens. The Qwen/OpenAI-compatible surface exposes direct per-response chat API usage. Because each chat response re-sends prior history, R3 context budget uses peak single-response usage.total_tokens as the context-size proxy; cumulative billable_total_tokens is recorded separately. The old numeric budgets are not transferable without remeasurement under this rule.
required_sequence: Pin QWEN_MODEL_SNAPSHOT to an exact dated/snapshot id.
Run one non-scored telemetry probe per arm to measure direct prompt, tool, and response usage.
Reset per-case budgets on the Qwen surface before calibration.
Revalidate every winnable-in-principle walkthrough on the Qwen surface, especially the budget-bound triage path.
Only after winnability and R3 budget binding pass, run the authorized calibration trials.

budget_policy.model_prompt_and_completion_tokens_count: counted through peak single-response total_tokens for context budget; cumulative prompt/completion sums are recorded separately
budget_policy.live_truncation: Stop issuing further model/tool work once accumulated usage exceeds a budget dimension.

case_specific_notes.fusion-v03-budget-bound-ledger-triage: Must rerun winnability walkthrough on Qwen because the four-call Codex path may have different token economics on direct API.
case_specific_notes.fusion-v03-cross-window-recall-gap-v2: Budget should be set after measuring two-episode prompt and note/tool overhead on the pinned snapshot.
case_specific_notes.fusion-v03-stale-holder-collapse: Old Codex negative-control grandfathering does not substitute for Qwen-surface arm purity; any Qwen freeze claim requires Qwen telemetry or explicit owner grandfathering.
